boundingBox.description: Geographic bounding box defining the scan area. Provide north/south/east/west coordinates.
boundingBox.title: Bounding Box

circleCenter.description: Center point for a circular scan area. Use with radiusKm.
circleCenter.title: Circle Center

customGeolocation.description: Custom GeoJSON Polygon defining the scan boundary.
customGeolocation.title: Custom Geolocation (GeoJSON Polygon)

deduplicateResults.description: Remove duplicate businesses that appear in multiple adjacent grid cells.
deduplicateResults.title: Deduplicate Results

enrichDetails.description: Open each place's page for extra fields (price level, Plus Code, photo sample, rating histogram, open/closed status). Slower; leave off for large exports since listing fields are always collected.
enrichDetails.title: Enrich Place Details

language.description: Language for Google Maps interface and results.
language.title: Language

locationName.description: Name of a public Google Maps location (e.g., 'Brooklyn, NY'). Google resolves its real center anonymously, then the actor scans the user-controlled radiusKm around it. Use boundingBox or GeoJSON for exact boundaries.
locationName.title: Location Name

maxPagesPerCell.description: How many 20-result pages to read per cell. Deeper pages surface more businesses — page 1 finds about 20% of a cell's places, page 9 finds all of them.
maxPagesPerCell.title: Max Pages Per Cell

maxPlacesPerCell.description: Maximum businesses to collect from each grid cell (1–260; Google's ranked window for one cell reaches roughly 136–213 places).
maxPlacesPerCell.title: Max Places Per Cell

maxTotalResults.description: Maximum total businesses to extract across all cells. Stops scanning when reached.
maxTotalResults.title: Max Total Results

minRating.description: Only include businesses with a rating at or above this value (1.0–5.0). Leave empty to include all.
minRating.title: Minimum Rating

radiusKm.description: Radius in kilometers for circular scan area (used with circleCenter or locationName).
radiusKm.title: Radius (km)

searchQuery.description: Type of business to search for (e.g., 'pharmacy', 'restaurant', 'dentist').
searchQuery.title: Search Query

zoomLevel.description: Controls grid cell granularity. Higher = smaller cells, more thorough coverage.
zoomLevel.title: Zoom Level
